name: TIC 150441969
description: A red giant observed by TESS, 18.2 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,280 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.85 solar masses and 18.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,277 K at its surface.
